newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares to rest after record run.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares to rest after record run.

text.p: 0730 GMT - Bel-20 to take a break after setting yet another record high on Thursday with bonds flat to weaker and dollar slightly lower; German IBIS Dax .GDAXI off 0.4 percent.

* Small caps to take front stage with focus on data communcations firm Telinfo, which lost 3.18 percent on Thursday, ahead of news of capital increase; construction and dredging firm CFE, which rose 9.27 percent on broker upgrades on Thursday; and stainless steel specialists Fafer on news controlling shareholder wants to sell.
* Brussels-listed South African gold mines also seen suffering on overnight plunge of metal to 12-year lows.
